title: cli: a hard kill or Ctrl+C during the `os skills` swap phase can leave mixed skill directories that only `--force` repairs, and the next write deletes the stranded old copies
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTyMahdAdhXSzgy2nt

Filing gate: ① product defect · Source: fleet · out-of-scope finding of PR #35495 (card #35079), named in its Acceptance notes and os-dev-report 7008338749; L1 ACCEPT 7008910233 ruled a card owed. ⛔ Not a claim.

Grade: area:build · Bug · Impeded · rare (a kill inside a millisecond rename window) · read from the code → p3.

## Business reason

A user who presses Ctrl+C (or whose machine loses power) while `os skills install` / `update` is swapping directories can be left with some skills at the new version and some at the old, under a record that matches neither. The only way out is `--force`, the flag PR #35495 removed the need for on every failure the process survives.

## What happens

After PR #35495, `applySkillsWrite` (`packages/cli/src/utils/skills-install-state.ts`) stages new skills in a hidden sibling, renames each old directory aside into `<staging>/old`, renames the staged copy into place, and renames the record last; a thrown error undoes the renames. A hard kill (SIGKILL, power loss) or Node's default SIGINT exits without running that undo. The next write's `removeStagingLeftovers` then deletes the leftover staging directory, including the `old/` copies the kill stranded, so the old versions cannot be recovered either.

## Expected

An interrupted swap is detected and completed or rolled back by the next run: for example a small journal written before the first rename, read and replayed in `runSkillsWrite` (`packages/cli/src/utils/skills-command.ts`) before the plan is computed, so leftovers are restored rather than deleted.

## Done when

A pin that stops a write after the first skill's swap and before the record rename (simulating the kill) shows that the next plain `os skills update` ends with every skill and the record at one version, without `--force`.

Who acts: the area that owns `packages/cli` (area:build, CLI area).
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue skills staging swap interrupted` → 6 hits; the only related one is #35079 (the parent card, fixed by PR #35495); none covers the kill window.
